name: @furifont/monorepo
description: A Japanese font that shows furigana without changing the text
author: Anthony Fu <anthonyfu117@hotmail.com>

scripts.ci: pnpm run lint && pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run knip && pnpm run test
scripts.prepare: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && simple-git-hooks && skills experimental_sync -y

scripts-info.setup: Install dependencies and the test browsers, then build; run it as `pnpm run setup`
scripts-info.build: Build every package, in dependency order, skipping what is cached
scripts-info.dev: Run the app with a live studio and this version's released fonts (build the packages first)
scripts-info.storybook: Run Storybook, where the Open Graph image is composed from the app's components
scripts-info.fonts: Build every prebuilt font, OpenType and WOFF2, into dist/fonts
scripts-info.fonts:fetch: Download the fonts the site serves from this version's GitHub Release into .cache/fonts
scripts-info.dict:update: Download JMdict, JmdictFurigana, KANJIDIC2 and the JLPT lists and recompile the dictionary
scripts-info.dict:audit: List the dictionary's runs and common compounds a font with the default options shows wrong (build the packages first)
scripts-info.knip: Find unused files, exports and dependencies
scripts-info.release: Bump every package, then commit, tag and push: CI publishes and attaches the fonts
scripts-info.test: Run the unit and font tests
scripts-info.test:e2e: Run the browser rendering tests (needs Playwright browsers)
scripts-info.ci: Run the full continuous integration pipeline
scripts-info.prepare: Set up git hooks and skills

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: pnpm i --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --offline && pnpm run ci && pnpx nano-staged
